blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) is awaiting Washington’s response to the draft Pax Silica framework agreement after receiving negotiating guidance from the Office of the President, according to Malacañang. While the signing of the controversial deal remains uncertain, the Philippine government hopes it will take place in time for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit later this month. In a briefing on Wednesday, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the BCDA had submitted a memorandum to the Office of the President, through the Office of the Executive Secretary, seeking guidance for the final […]...
